description.title: חרדות בפוליסה לביטוח ימי
description.summary: This table lists exclusions to coverage under a marine insurance policy for yachts and boats from Shirbit. It details specific events or items for which a claim will not be allowed.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת חריגות לפוליסת ביטוח ימי ליאכטות וסירות של שירביט. ניתן להשתמש בה כדי לבדוק אם נזק או אובדן ספציפיים מכוסים על ידי הפוליסה, תוך התייחסות לסעיפים כמו מנועים חיצוניים, סירות, ציוד חשמלי וליקויים בעיצוב. החריגות כוללות מנוע חיצוני שנפל, סירה שמהירותה המתוכננת עולה על 17 קשר, חומרי צריכה, ציוד דיג, חיפוי, תיקונים, ליקויים בעיצוב או בבנייה, מנוע וחיבורים, ציוד חשמלי וסוללות. מנוע חיצוני, סירה מהירה, ציוד דיג, חיפוי, ליקויים בבנייה, מנוע חשמלי הם דוגמאות לחריגות.
notable_values: outboard motor: dropping off or falling overboard
sheathing repairs: excluded unless due to stranding/sinking/fire/collision

טבלה: חרדות בפוליסה לביטוח ימי
This table lists exclusions to coverage under a marine insurance policy for yachts and boats from Shirbit. It details specific events or items for which a claim will not be allowed.
ממדים: exclusion clause number, description of exclusion

9.3 this insurance covers the expense of sighting the bottom after a stranding, if reasonably incurred specially for that purpose, even if no damage be found.
10. EXCLUSIONS
No claim shall be allowed in respect of any
0,1
10.1,outboard motor dropping off or falling overboard
10.2,"ship's boat having a maximum designed speed exceeding 17 knots, unless such boat is specially covered herein and subject also to the conditions of the Speedboat Cause 19 below, or is on the parent Vessel or laid up ashore"
10.3,ship's boat not permanently marked with the name of the parent Vessel.
10.4,"sails and protective covers split by the wind or blown away while set, unless in consequence of damage to the spars to which sails are bent, or occasioned by the Vessel being stranded or in collision or contact with any external substance (ice included) other than water"
10.5,"sails, masts, spars or standing and running rigging while the Vessel is racing, unless the loss or damage is caused by the Vessel being stranded, sunk, burnt, on fre or in collision or contact with any external substance (ice included) other than water"
10.6,personal effects
10.7,"consumable stores, fshing gear or moorings"
10.8,"sheathing, or repairs thereto, unless the loss or damage has been caused by the Vessel being stranded, sunk, burnt, on fre or in collision or contact with any external substance (ice included) other than water"
10.9,loss or expenditure incurred in remedying a fault in design or construction or any cost or expense incurred by reason of betterment or alteration in design or construction
10.10,"motor and connections (but not strut shaft or propeller) electrical equipment and batteries and connections, where the loss or"
8. CHANGE OF OWNERSHIP
This Clause 8 shall prevail notwithstanding any provision whether written typed or printed in this insurance inconsistent herewith.
